### some pointer stuff (5) {.smaller}

::::: {.columns}

:::: {.column width=60%}

```{.biggercode}
int array[3] = {0x12, 0x45, 0x67};
int single = 0x78;
int *ptr;
ptr = &array[0];
```
<hr/>
<em>`ptr[2] = 0xFF;`</em>
<em>`*(ptr + 2) = 0xFF;`</em>
<hr/>
`int *temp1; temp1 = ptr +_2;`<br/>
<em>`*temp1 = 0xFF;`</em><br/>
<hr/>
`int *temp2; temp2 = &ptr[2];`<br/>
<em>`*temp2 = 0xFF;`</em><br/>

::::

:::: {.column width=39% .my-full}

![](/intro/texfig/selectedC-memory.figure-9.svg){fig-alt="same memory as previous slide, except now array[2] is highlighted and set to 0xFF."}
